title: OTP 28: Crashes on Ubuntu 24.04 x86 when running in container emulating x86 on ARM Mac

labels.name: not OTP
labels.description: This issue should not be reported to OTP

body:
**Describe the bug**
Runtime crashes on startup

**To Reproduce**

1. Using an ARM Mac (M1 v15.5)
2. Start a fresh ubuntu 24.04 x86 container using docker.
3. Open a shell into the running container
  1. Install brew
  2. Install gleam using brew (which installs erlang OTP 28.0)
  3. Run `erl`

**Expected behavior**

I expected running `erl` to not crash

**Affected versions**

28.0

**Additional context**

```bash
olian@ubuntu:/Users/olian/Documents/demo$ erl > out
Kernel pid terminated (application_controller) ("{application_start_failure,kernel,{{shutdown,{failed_to_start_child,user,nouser}},{kernel,start,[normal,[]]}}}")
```
